name: Cool
text: Cool is an anglicized form of Cumhall, the father of Fionn mac Cumhaill. The related forms cooleen and coolun render the Irish word cúilín. See Cumhall.

attributes.attribute: anglicization of Cumhall, father of Fionn mac Cumhaill

okr.objective: Route readers who search Cool to the article on Cumhall.
key_results: Identify Cool as an anglicization of Cumhall.
